concept: RDS point-in-time recovery: undo an accidental delete
tests: Choosing how to recover from an erroneous data deletion with automated backups enabled.
expected: Point-in-time recovery to the moment just before the deletion (any second within the retention window). Triggers: "accidentally deleted rows N minutes ago", "automated backups, 7-day retention".
why_not: A Read Replica already contains the deletion (asynchronous replication); reboot with failover does not undo changes; the oldest manual snapshot loses far more data.
